title: Keep the project catalog on a dedicated branch
summary: Use a project-owned branch for evolving idea and feature records. Record the upstream starter revision so adopters can audit and update their own copy.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Keeps project data with its owner.
Makes the selected starter revision recoverable.
risks: Default-branch visitors need a clear discovery link.
Upgrades can overwrite data if the target is assumed.

evidence.claim: README-HQ uses a dedicated catalog branch for project-owned records.
v0.0.2 documents a manual isolated copy and a read-only planner.
